statement: A reduced frame potential of root degree n>=4 has leading coefficient vanishing to order at least floor(n/2)+1 at the retained infinity point; the bound is sharp and yields component degrees (3n+4,3n+3,4) for even n and (3n+2,3n+1,4) for odd n.
